listing.name: KMU
listing.summary: Currently in pre-release. Requires LazyLib and LunaLib. Safe to enable mid-save, uninstalled via settings.
listing.aiSummary: Adds political map layers showing faction territories, alliances, and claims to the sector and intel screens.
listing.partOfThreadTitle: Political Map - Sector Map Layers - KMU

description: Displays populated colonies and their allegiances using Faction, Alliance, and Claim views. The interface appears on the map and intel screens with a collapsible sidebar for controls. It supports toggling visual settings for decivilised colonies and integrates with other mods like Fast Rendering and Nexerelin.

changelog.0.2.1: Fixed a rare issue where the map label font did not load properly under Fast Rendering and VRAM Optimizer . Reported by lChronosl . The dependencies section in mod_info.json is moved to the bottom of the file. Some mod installers read the first id field they see and overwrite dependency mods with the one being installed. Reported by NH4CI at Fossic .
changelog.0.2.0: Fast Rendering crash resolved on the FR side. You'll get a note in-game if your FR needs an update to 0.9.1rc1+ . Props to Genir . Nebulae in Starscape mode no longer disregard draw order under campaign speed-up. Reported by MiniRockytheOracle . Non-API calls to vanilla or mod internals are guarded and stand down related functionality with a player notice, instead of crashing. Added a setting to toggle Decivilised colonies painting the map in absence of any factions, enabled by default. Decivilised systems - Should draw territory under the Map - Politics - Visuals tab. Requested by NoticeMeSenpai . The default survey level required for the map to see Decivilised colonies is set to full by default. If it's not your first install, your settings are untouched. Revealed faction colonies also reveal all Decivilised colonies in the system. Simplified Chinese localisation has been added as separate release ZIP.
